title: Practice 5: при- and у-: arriving, and leaving

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **уйти** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: You're not going to get far in this old tub.
exercises.why: **уедешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of уехать: perfective (imperfective partner: уезжать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom seems to have made off with the elk carcass.
exercises.why: **убежал** — past tense (masculine) of убежать: perfective (imperfective partner: убегать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: We brought cheese and wine from France.
exercises.why: **привозим** — present tense (1st person plural) of привозить: imperfective (perfective partner: привезти).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.ru: Мы ___ сыр и вино из Франции.

exercises.q: It took many years to build it.
exercises.why: **ушло** — past tense (neuter) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
